message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python3 -c "
import struct
data = open('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame','rb').read()
header_len = 92
cbytes = 36733
coffsets = data[header_len+cbytes:header_len+cbytes+270]
print('coffsets hex:', coffsets[:32].hex())
# Parse blosc chunk header
# version, versionlz, flags, typesize
version = coffsets[0]
versionlz = coffsets[1]
flags = coffsets[2]
typesize = coffsets[3]
nbytes = struct.unpack('<i', coffsets[4:8])[0]
blocksize = struct.unpack('<i', coffsets[8:12])[0]
cbytes_chunk = struct.unpack('<i', coffsets[12:16])[0]
print(f'version={version} versionlz={versionlz} flags={flags:#x} typesize={typesize}')
print(f'nbytes={nbytes} blocksize={blocksize} cbytes={cbytes_chunk}')
print(f'expected nbytes = nchunks*8 = {10*8}')
"
